system.description:
• Effect: When you prepare spells, you may hang one prepared spell of 4th level or lower that affects you on yourself, spending its slot, and name what sets it off (falling below half your HP, being Paralysed, a word you speak).
  • When that happens it casts itself at once, out of turn.
  • One spell hangs at a time; it is lost if you prepare again before it goes off.
